name: check-workflow
description: Sync the standard ForgeSteward workflow block into a repository, then submit a PR or MR without merging.

interface.shortDescription: Sync the standard workflow block via a PR or MR.
interface.longDescription: Add or replace the ForgeSteward workflow block in AGENTS.md from the bundled template, ensure CLAUDE.md imports it, validate, and submit a PR or MR without merging. Text outside the managed block is untouched; explicit check-only requests remain read-only.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $forge-steward-check-workflow to sync this repository's ForgeSteward workflow block and agent entry import with the bundled template, validate, then commit, push, and open a PR or MR without merging.
